title: MassPermits — coverage ended: Needham, MA
description: MassPermits no longer receives building-permit records for Needham, MA. This feed has stopped and is kept only so its address does not break. The last permit this feed carried was issued 2026-06-30. It is not a current feed and must not be read as one. Live coverage is listed at https://masspermits.com/permits/ and the sources still publishing are itemised at https://masspermits.com/research/coverage.

_masspermits.source: Compiled from public municipal building-permit records published by Massachusetts cities and towns.
